paragraphs: R' Shabbetai. Jerusalem Talmud, Pe'ah. This R' Shabbetai's widow was dissipating the property: Jerusalem Talmud, Makkot. R' Shabbetai said that Hizkiyah said: Gittin 26, beginning of b; Bava Batra 163a; Jerusalem Talmud, Gittin 3:2. In R' Hiyya's name: Jerusalem Talmud, Sanhedrin chapter 3. R' Shuvtai and Rav Hisda before R' Yosi: Jerusalem Talmud, Ha-Shutafin She-Nadru [the checked text has R' Hassida]. R' Yosi in his name: Hallah 2:3 [2:1:13 in the checked edition]. In Ha-Megaresh, R' Yasa bar R' Shabbetai: it appears it should read ‘R' Shabbatai said,’ or it means ‘in R' Shabbetai's name.’ R' Hanina son of R' Shabbetai, or Shuvtai.
